products.title: The Slow Wave Protocol
products.body_html:
A 34-page guide to the twenty minutes before bed.

Not an app. Not a tracker. No notifications. Just a clear, practical walkthrough of how to set up a room and an evening routine that actually lets you switch off — written for people who have already tried the apps and are still lying there at 1am.

What's inside

  • The room audit — light, temperature, sound, and the four things most bedrooms get wrong
  • A 20-minute wind-down sequence you can actually stick to
  • The screen problem, and what to do if giving them up isn't realistic
  • Building a routine that survives a bad week
  • Two printable one-page checklists

Format

PDF, delivered by email the moment you order. Read it on anything.

This guide is general educational information about sleep environment and routine. It is not medical advice, and it is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. If you have ongoing sleep difficulties, please speak to your doctor.

products.title: The Silk Mask
products.body_html:
Blocks all of the light. That's the whole job, and most masks don't do it.

Cheap masks leak light at the bridge of the nose. This one is contoured there, so the seal holds when you turn over. Mulberry silk on both faces — cool against the skin, and it doesn't drag at the corners of your eyes the way cotton does.

Specifications

  • 22-momme mulberry silk, both sides
  • Contoured nose seal — blocks 100% of light
  • Adjustable flat-back strap, no lump against the pillow
  • 45g
  • Hand wash cold, dry flat

Made for

Light sleepers. Shift workers. Anyone whose partner reads late. Anyone who has given up on the streetlight outside.

products.title: The Weighted Eye Pillow
products.body_html:
280 grams across the eyes. Heavier than you expect, which is the point.

A gentle, even weight that settles the face at the end of the day. Linen outer, flaxseed fill, no fragrance — scented versions tend to be overwhelming twenty minutes in, so this one is deliberately plain.

Specifications

  • 280g flaxseed fill, evenly chambered so it doesn't pool to one side
  • Washed linen cover, removable
  • Unscented
  • Can be chilled — 20 minutes in the fridge, not the freezer
  • Cover machine washable, inner spot clean only

Made for

The end of a long screen day. Use it for ten minutes before bed, not through the night.

The Silk Mask, the Weighted Eye Pillow, and The Slow Wave Protocol — bought together, because individually they're objects, and together they're a routine. The guide arrives by email straight away; the rest ships the next working day.
